pages.text: Frost wastes and the giants' taiga, the Ironwood forest, the fjords and a cold sea. In the south the rift of Muspelheim smoulders, in the north the mists of Niflheim creep.
Somewhere Idunn's orchard blooms: her apples of youth ripen on the leaves like fruit. The nights are long, and by day the sun drives the trolls under the earth.
